answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. What survives to the sable is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A spiral of per-task receipts records who did what, and the reef of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
